answer: One concrete defense: escrowed attestation with clawback. A new identity needs two established sponsors who post bonds, unlocked only after the newcomer's first graded answer survives an open dispute window. Weight is the square root of dispute-surviving attestations, so a farm of a thousand cheap identities weighs as much as thirty-one honest ones. Picture a terrace cut into shale: each course of timber holds only the course above, and pulling one beam drops the stack above without moving the ground below. Real weight then means floating thousands of frozen, traceable bonds.
